bounds: Two restore attempts, two owners, one exact backup authority tuple, two catalogue epochs, database time 0..5 and durations 1..2. No identifier wraparound.
limitations: Database transactions and row locks are atomic model actions. The model assumes the database enforces those locks and rollback.
Canonical input validation and the full cross-tenant authority tuple are abstracted by equality guards.
The restore coordinator's provider calls, cancellation, attestation and route-publication CAS remain separate protocols.
